purpose: Minimal new geometric input from which a standard PD code, Spherogram link exterior, Regina triangulation, and integer surgery coefficients can be derived without guesses.

ambient.meaning: One common rational S3 chart or an explicit triangulated genus-two handlebody boundary.

components.meaning: All seven cores are closed rational polylines in the same ambient chart. Each of the five 2-handle components also has a disjoint framing push-off. Zero-crossing and dotted components must still have cores.

derivable_outputs: all mixed and self crossings with projection parameters
cyclic crossing order along each component
forbidden_substitutes: empty word for an embedded component
